caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object that appears to be a handle or bracket with a sturdy base for mounting. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black, indicating it is made from a dark, solid material like iron or steel. The handle forms an irregular, roughly rectangular loop with broad sides and curves upward at both ends, each terminating in a symmetrical outward-facing spiral or scroll. The central opening of the handle is wide and irregularly shaped, following the outer contours. The base of the object is broad, flat, and has a scalloped edge with three visible holes likely used for securing the object with screws or bolts. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is no shading or detail outside of the object itself. Near the bottom right, there are two signatures: “J.Bellamy” and “J.LIPKIN.”
